# Durable finding template

- Classification: platform / private project / both
- Status: verified / user-reported / unresolved / superseded
- Observation and evidence:
- Applicable tool versions/platforms:

Store this filled record privately if it contains project or machine details. Split mixed findings; public records never link back to a real private project. Update existing canonical notes instead of duplicating them. Temporary experiments remain in logs.
